name: Orenthil Whisperwind
summary: Beneath Teldrassil’s boughs, Orenthil Whisperwind lives among the night elves of Shadowglen.

sections.title: A Friendly Face in Teldrassil
sections.body: Orenthil Whisperwind lives among the night elves beneath Teldrassil’s canopy in Shadowglen. Little is known of his personal history.

faq.answer: Orenthil Whisperwind is a night elf found in Shadowglen on Teldrassil. He welcomes adventurers setting out into the boughs of the World Tree.

faq.q: Where can I find Orenthil Whisperwind?
faq.answer: You can find Orenthil Whisperwind in Shadowglen, the night elf starting settlement within Teldrassil.
